name: Numerical Tie-Break Encoding
description: Reframed the lexicographical tie-breaker as minimizing an n-digit number. This preserves the exact same requirement but disrupts the direct mapping to "ascending index-order DFS" that the models rely on, forcing them to reason about the objective function rather than pattern-matching to a standard backtracking template. The adversarial test suite warning was also removed to comply with gate feedback.
